method: LocateAnything-3B proposals, then every box inspected individually as a cropped patch, and recall spot-checked on four magnified tiles of the cattle band
verification: 46 of 46 proposals confirmed as real cattle (precision ~1.00); no unboxed cattle found in the tile scan. Independent of the student detector, so usable to score it.
caveat: Single frame, single annotator. Boxes originate from the teacher, so any animal the teacher and the annotator both missed is absent from this ground truth.
